### ConnectionHealth

A connection's health, which Kantel sets from its token refreshes (#328), apart from its status.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `"ok"` or `"refresh_failing"` or `"needs_reconnect"` | yes | `ok`: the last refresh worked. `refresh_failing`: the last refresh failed in a way that may pass (no answer, a 5xx, a rate limit); the connection stays active and Kantel retries with backoff. `needs_reconnect`: the provider refused the refresh token; requests are refused with `connection_reconnect_required` until a person connects it again. |
| `since` | integer | yes | Epoch milliseconds, UTC. |
| `reason` | string | no | The last failure, in plain words. Never a secret. |
| `failures` | integer | no | Refreshes that failed in a row. (minimum 0) |
| `retryAt` | integer | no | When Kantel tries again. Epoch milliseconds, UTC. |
| `refreshedAt` | integer | no | When a refresh last worked. Epoch milliseconds, UTC. |

### EgressRefusalCode

Why the egress gate refused a sandbox's request (#331): `host_not_bound` (the placeholder's connection is not for that host), `raw_secret` (a stored secret's own value, not its placeholder), `unknown_placeholder`, `ambiguous_placeholder`, `connection_not_usable`, `needs_reauth`, `https_required`, `rule_denied`, `approval_pending`, `egress_denied` or `egress_unavailable`.

One of: `"host_not_bound"` or `"raw_secret"` or `"unknown_placeholder"` or `"ambiguous_placeholder"` or `"connection_not_usable"` or `"needs_reauth"` or `"https_required"` or `"rule_denied"` or `"approval_pending"` or `"egress_denied"` or `"egress_unavailable"`.

### MessageVia

How a message reaches the agent: `prompt` starts a run (queued behind one in progress), `steer` reaches a run in progress at its next model call, without stopping it (usually right after the tool call in progress), and `followUp` runs after the current run ends. A steer or follow-up to a session with no run in progress starts one, as a prompt does, so a message sent just as a run ends is never lost.

One of: `"prompt"` or `"steer"` or `"followUp"`.

| `provider` | string | no | Who serves the model, for grouping, such as `Anthropic`. |

### SessionModelState

The models a session's messages may name (`model` and `thinking` on a message), in the order to show them; `selected`, what the session's next model call uses (its agent profile's until its first message names another); `defaults`, what its agent profile names; and `locked`, set once the session has started. The first message fixes the session's model, so everything in its transcript comes from one model; its thinking level can change on any later message, though a change may cost the next call the provider's prompt cache.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `models` | [ModelOption](/api/reference/types/#modeloption)[] | yes |  |
| `selected` | [ModelSelection](/api/reference/types/#modelselection) | no |  |
| `defaults` | [ModelSelection](/api/reference/types/#modelselection) | no |  |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Set once the session has started (it holds a message): its model is `selected`'s for good, and a message naming another is a `conflict`. Its thinking level can still change. |

A connection as a session sees it: no credential.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | [ConnectionKind](/api/reference/types/#connectionkind) | yes |  |
| `templateId` | string | no |  |
| `owner` | `"organisation"` or `"project"` or `"user"` | yes |  |
| `account` | [ConnectionAccount](/api/reference/types/#connectionaccount) | no |  |
| `hosts` | string[] | yes |  |
| `mcpUrl` | string | no |  |
| `placeholder` | string | no | The connection's placeholder (#331), sent in the credential's place. |
| `env` | string | no | The sandbox's environment variable holding it, such as KANTEL_CONNECTION_GITHUB. |

### Usage

Model token usage and cost: the session's running total on a snapshot and in a `usage` op, the answer's on a run result. `inputTokens` excludes input read from or written to the provider's cache.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inputTokens` | integer | yes |  |
| `outputTokens` | integer | yes |  |
| `cacheReadTokens` | integer | no |  |
| `cacheWriteTokens` | integer | no |  |
| `costUsd` | number | no |  |

### UserAttachment

A file sent with a message. The model saw its contents; `text` leaves them out.

| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `size` | number | yes |  |
| `kind` | `"image"` or `"file"` or `"text"` | yes |  |
